issues.claim: Emporium Sweets, 1 Lincoln Ave (group D, category 'Candy and gift retail (exclusion candidate)')
issues.problem: Excluded type still in the list. It is a candy/food retailer (candy, fudge, specialty chocolates) per the Patch story the entry itself cites, and the entry's own notes concede it 'probably falls under the food-retail exclusion'. Any excluded type remaining fails the zone.
issues.fix: Delete the entry (keep the fact in categories_thin/caveats if useful for context). It is not a prospect.

issues.claim: Fuel4, 621 Middlesex Ave (group C, 'Auto fuel / service station')
issues.problem: Second borderline exclusion: a fuel/service station is fuel-and-convenience retail, which sits inside the mapper's own 'convenience/fuel-retail exclusion'. It is kept deliberately 'so triage can decide', which pushes the scope decision downstream instead of resolving it.
issues.fix: Resolve now: if the fuel-retail exclusion applies, remove it; if it is kept, state the reason explicitly (independent operator, repair work) so triage does not have to relitigate.

issues.claim: Coverage of auto glass / windshield shops in Metuchen
issues.problem: A whole sub-category is missing. Two Metuchen-address auto glass shops surfaced immediately (7 Days Auto Glass, 481 Memorial Pkwy; Steadfast Auto Glass, 913 Middlesex Ave - the same yard already in the list). The list has zero auto glass entries and the caveats never mention the category.
issues.fix: Add both (subject to phone confirmation) and note that the 913 Middlesex Ave yard now has a fifth possible tenant.

issues.claim: Coverage of roofing, landscaping and masonry
issues.problem: My searches returned several Metuchen-addressed businesses that are absent: Above-All Roofing & Construction (195 Central Ave), A1 Dependable NJ Roofing/Chimney & Gutter (Metuchen listing), Speedy's Landscaping, by Design Landscape (104 Norcross Ave), ROR Contractor LLC. None appear in the list or in categories_thin.
issues.fix: Add them as leads (marked 'directory-only, confirm by phone') or record them in categories_thin with the reason they were dropped.

issues.claim: Lock Sharp US - address 'Unknown (Metuchen service area)', note 'likely a mobile locksmith with no Metuchen storefront'
issues.problem: Contradicted by the page the entry cites: it states 'located at 406 Main St 3rd Floor, Ste 25, Metuchen, NJ, 08840'. So it is a Metuchen office-suite business, not an address-less mobile operator.
issues.fix: Fill the address as 406 Main St, 3rd Floor, Ste 25 and replace the 'likely mobile' note.

issues.claim: Innovative Exteriors - note says the Metuchen base is 'unconfirmed (inference from an earlier search summary only)'
issues.problem: The cited page does confirm it: 'Innovative Exteriors operates from our Metuchen, NJ office and holds all necessary licensing (NJ HICL #13VH13098400)'. The note understates the evidence.
issues.fix: Upgrade the note to confirmed-by-own-site and keep the licence number.

issues.claim: Websites left blank for businesses that have their own site
issues.problem: Supercars Garage (188 Main St) has its own site (supercarsgarage.com contact page), and the Costello-Runyon Downtown Metuchen page links costello-runyon.com; both entries carry an empty website field. Not wrong, but it costs the team the best outreach channel.
issues.fix: Populate those two website fields and spot-check the remaining blanks against the source pages.

issues.claim: Entries resting only on one bulk directory (AG Electrical, Industrial Cooling, Protocal, Wesco Oxygen, East Coast Ship Supply, Schundler, Graphic Equipment, Brazill Brothers, Peerless Business Forms, Creative Print, plus Sterling Key & Lock, Always Affordable Moving, Jersey Pro Painters, Strongmile Movers)
issues.problem: I could re-open the directory pages and see the listings, but nothing independently shows these are still trading, and several have no phone at all. They are honest 'leads', not verified businesses - roughly a dozen entries of uncertain value to the team.
issues.fix: Keep, but mark them clearly as unverified and put them behind the confirmed entries in triage; do not count them toward the zone's prospect total.
